text: WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis: tuberculosis preventive treatment, second edition 204 Those not procuring through the Global Drug Facility mechanism may face a higher price for a product of guaranteed quality, as well as differences in costs if the 750mg formulation is used instead of the 250mg. However, this variation in the exact per patient budget impact may not have had a major influence in the NTP survey responses. Certainty of evidence of required resources What is the certainty of the evidence of resource requirements (costs)? Judgement Research evidence Additional considerations • Very low • Low • Moderate • High • No included studies A single self-administered questionnaire and completion rate of only 60%. The pricing of the Global Drug Facility medications is standardized for all countries eligible. Key considerations expressed by GDG members when making a judgement of LOW for the certainty of evidence of required resources were that there was only one survey reviewed and that there was no evidence on costs for implementation.
